normalized_text: Apollo 16 launched on April 16, 1972, from Launch Pad 39A. The crew included Commander John Young, Command Module Pilot Ken Mattingly, and Lunar Module Pilot Charles Duke. The Saturn V third stage reignited to send the spacecraft toward the Moon.
